description:
Working at Freudenberg: "We will wow your world!" This is our promise. As a global technology group, we not only make the world cleaner, healthier and more comfortable, but also offer our 52,000 employees a networked and diverse environment where everyone can thrive individually. Be surprised and experience your own wow moments. Together with our partners, customers and the world of science, we develop leading-edge technologies, and excellent products and services for about 40 markets and for thousands of applications: seals, vibration control components, batteries and fuel cells, technical textiles, filters, cleaning technologies and products, specialty chemicals and medical products.

You support our team as Procurement Professional with Italian

Responsibilities:

  • Execution of the strategy defined by the Commodity / Lead Buyer;
  • Trigger purchase orders based on info records stored in SAP. Follow up purchase orders until goods received. (dunning if necessary);
  • Verify and enter order confirmations (quantities and delivery date). If necessary, the commodity Buyer will adjust/release PO, if price/conditions are not correct;
  • Verify the invoices (quantity variance) and release them if necessary. Release of the invoices with cost and condition variances is carried out by the Commodity Buyer;
  • Compliance assure adherence to entity requirements and to the OTD target and a low stock level;
  • Forwarding and tracking of Q-notifications internally with quality assurance and externally to the supplier;
  • First contact person - internally Production Planning and externally to the supplier - for quality and delivery date deviations;
  • First contact person for escalations at supplier and Commodity Buyer.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Business Administration, or a related field;
  • Fluent in English and Italian, both written and spoken;
  • Experience in operational procurement is desirable;
  • SAP knowledge is an advantage;
  • Strong communication and organizational skills;
  • Independent and structured way of working;
  • High level of reliability and attention to detail;
  • Ability to work effectively in an international environment.

If you like to make a difference and if you would like to be a part of a growing, successful company, then this is the moment to join Freudenberg and become part of a great team!
